# Documentary cross-reference

Each reference set expands three labels. Direct means the document names the check, source, module or runner (or a matching Swift filter). Suite means an explicit source/runner dependency or the documented Swift aggregate includes it. Governing supplies the curated family-level plan/contract when the document describes the feature without naming that implementation symbol. These are usage/authority references, not assertions that every document specifies every internal assertion. A document can be both a plan and a qualification ledger.

## R001

No explicit documentary mention found; use the source and containing runner. This is recorded rather than inventing a plan reference.
